QUOTE: The asm is gated on `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM`, which is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is on and the compiler is GNU-compatible (`__GNUC__`) or ARM Compiler (`__ARMCC_VERSION`) (`constant_time_impl.h:40-52`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros (__GNUC__, __ARMCC_VERSION) in the header, which conveys that it is derived. It does not say outright that it is absent from mbedtls_config.h, but the derivation mechanism is stated.
